units.source_text: 公主终于走出储藏室，二人在日常的起居室中盥洗并进早粥。

en.t: At last the princess came out of the storeroom, and the two of them washed and had their morning rice gruel in the sitting room they used every day.

units.source_text: 丧家装饰，此时似嫌不祥，故用屏风将做佛事的东室遮蔽。

en.t: The mourning decorations now seemed inauspicious, so they used screens to conceal the eastern room where the Buddhist rites were being held.

units.source_text: 东室与正屋之间，张着淡橙色帷屏，此乃吉凶两用之色，并不十分触目。

en.t: Between the eastern room and the main building hung a pale orange curtain screen, a color used for both happy and sorrowful occasions, so it was not especially conspicuous.

units.source_text: 又设着一个两架的沉香木橱子，隐约表示欢庆之相。

en.t: They had also set out a two tier aloeswood cabinet, faintly suggesting an air of celebration.
All of this had been arranged by the Governor of Yamato.

units.source_text: 众侍女都把青蓝色丧服脱去，换上不甚鲜艳的棣棠色、暗红色、深紫色的衣服。

en.t: The ladies in waiting had all taken off their blue green mourning robes and changed into subdued garments of yellow, dark red, and deep purple.

units.source_text: 绿面枯叶色里子的围裙也换了淡紫色的。

en.t: Their aprons, green on the outside and lined in withered leaf color, had also been changed for pale purple ones.
They were all hurrying about in attendance.

units.source_text: 这宫邸内只有女人，诸事未免办理不周。

en.t: Since there were only women in the residence, arrangements for many things were inevitably incomplete.

units.source_text: 全赖大和守一人在那里操心，略雇几个人夫来打扫整理。

en.t: Everything depended on the Governor of Yamato alone, who worried over the work and hired a few laborers to clean and put things in order.

units.source_text: 现在意外地来了这个身份高贵的娇客，本来已经辞退的家臣闻知了，纷纷前来复职，都到事务所去当差。

en.t: Now that this noble and delicate guest had unexpectedly arrived, the retainers who had already been dismissed heard the news and came back one after another to resume their posts, all reporting for duty at the office.
